function.name: lookup_product_fact
function.description: Look up a fact (category, price) about one specific product by name. Use this to answer a question about a single named product.

name.description: The product's name, as the customer referred to it.

function.name: filter_products
function.description: List products matching an optional category and/or price range. Omit any argument you don't need to filter by; omitting all of them lists the whole catalog.

minPrice.description: Only products priced at or above this amount (inclusive). For 'more than $X', use a minPrice just above X (e.g. X + 0.01) — a product priced at exactly X must not match.

maxPrice.description: Only products priced at or below this amount (inclusive). For 'less than $X', use a maxPrice just under X (e.g. X - 0.01), never round down to the nearest whole dollar — a product priced at exactly X - 0.01 must still match.

function.name: view_cart
function.description: View the customer's current cart: every line item with its current price and quantity, and the live total.

function.name: add_to_cart
function.description: Add a quantity of a named product to the customer's cart. Calling this again for the same product adds more of it (quantities accumulate, they don't replace).

productName.description: The product's name, as the customer referred to it.

quantity.description: How many to add. Defaults to 1 if omitted.

function.name: remove_from_cart
function.description: Remove a quantity of a named product from the customer's cart. Omit quantity to remove the entire line for that product, however many are in the cart.

productName.description: The product's name, as the customer referred to it.

quantity.description: How many to remove. Omit to remove the whole line.

function.name: clear_cart
function.description: Remove every item from the customer's cart.

function.name: place_order
function.description: Place an order for everything currently in the customer's cart, at current catalog prices. Clears the cart on success.
